# NDRC/MIIT/NEA/NDA — Data Center Green Low-Carbon Development Action Plan (July 2024)

Original gov.cn URL (content_6962214) returned CRAWL_NOT_FOUND. Content recovered from the authoritative NDRC official site (ndrc.gov.cn, 发改环资〔2024〕970号, published 2024-07-23) and official NDRC Q&A.

## Key targets
- By end of 2025: overall rack utilization rate (上架率) no lower than 60%; average PUE (电能利用效率) below 1.5; renewable energy utilization rate growing 10% per year on average.
- By end of 2025: PUE of newly built and expanded large and super-large data centers cut to within 1.25; data center projects at national hub nodes (国家枢纽节点) PUE no higher than 1.2.
- By end of 2025: green power share of newly built data centers at national hub nodes over 80%.
- By end of 2030: average PUE, per-unit-compute energy efficiency and carbon efficiency reach internationally advanced levels; waste-heat utilization of new large+ data centers in northern heating regions clearly improved.
- New large/super-large data centers should be prioritized within national integrated computing-power network hub node clusters ("East Data, West Computing" 东数西算 rigid constraints); non-real-time compute facilities encouraged to migrate to western hub nodes.
- If a city already has data centers running 1+ year with overall rack utilization below 50%, in principle no new data center clusters or large/super-large projects will be approved.
- By end of 2025, new computing power at national hub nodes accounts for over 60% of the nation's new computing power.
- Six key tasks: layout optimization; strict energy/water efficiency requirements for new projects; retrofit of existing low-efficiency centers; raising renewable energy utilization; resource conservation (waste heat recovery, reclaimed water); promotion of energy-saving technologies (liquid cooling, evaporative cooling, heat pipes, fluorine pumps, DC power supply).
- Issued by: National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Energy Administration, National Data Administration.
